text.la: Ego dixi: In dimídio diérum meórum vadam ad portas ínferi.
text.en-US: I said: In the midst of my days I shall go to the gates of hell:

text.la: Quaesívi resíduum annórum meórum. Dixi: Non vidébo Dóminum Deum in terra vivéntium.
text.en-US: I sought for the residue of my years. I said: I shall not see the Lord God in the land of the living.

text.la: Non aspíciam hóminem ultra, et habitatórem quiétis.
text.en-US: I shall behold man no more, nor the inhabitant of rest.

text.la: Generátio mea abláta est, et convolúta est a me, quasi tabernáculum pastórum.
text.en-US: My generation is at an end, and it is rolled away from me, as a shepherd's tent.

text.la: Praecísa est velut a texénte, vita mea: dum adhuc ordírer, succídit me: de mane usque ad vésperam fínies me.
text.en-US: My life is cut off, as by a weaver: whilst I was yet but beginning, he cut me off: from morning even to night thou wilt make an end of me.

text.la: Sperábam usque ad mane, quasi leo sic contrívit ómnia ossa mea:
text.en-US: I hoped till morning, as a lion so hath he broken all my bones:

text.la: De mane usque ad vésperam fínies me: sicut pullus hirúndinis sic clamábo, meditábor ut colúmba:
text.en-US: From morning even to night thou wilt make an end of me. I will cry like a young swallow, I will meditate like a dove:

text.la: Attenuáti sunt óculi mei, suspiciéntes in excélsum.
text.en-US: My eyes are weakened looking upward:

text.la: Dómine, vim pátior, respónde pro me. Quid dicam, aut quid respondébit mihi, cum ipse fécerit?
text.en-US: Lord, I suffer violence, answer thou for me. What shall I say, or what shall he answer for me, whereas he himself hath done it?

text.la: Recogitábo tibi omnes annos meos in amaritúdine ánimae meae.
text.en-US: I will recount to thee all my years in the bitterness of my soul.

text.la: Dómine, si sic vívitur, et in tálibus vita spíritus mei, corrípies me, et vivificábis me. Ecce, in pace amaritúdo mea amaríssima:
text.en-US: O Lord, if man's life be such, and the life of my spirit be in such things as these, thou shalt correct me, and make me to live. Behold in peace is my bitterness most bitter:

text.la: Tu autem eruísti ánimam meam ut non períret: proiecísti post tergum tuum ómnia peccáta mea.
text.en-US: But thou hast delivered my soul that it should not perish, thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back.

text.la: Quia non inférnus confitébitur tibi, neque mors laudábit te: non exspectábunt qui descéndunt in lacum, veritátem tuam.
text.en-US: For hell shall not confess to thee, neither shall death praise thee: nor shall they that go down into the pit, look for thy truth.

text.la: Vivens vivens ipse confitébitur tibi, sicut et ego hódie: pater fíliis notam fáciet veritátem tuam.
text.en-US: The living, the living, he shall give praise to thee, as I do this day: the father shall make thy truth known to the children.

text.la: Dómine, salvum me fac et psalmos nostros cantábimus cunctis diébus vitae nostrae in domo Dómini.
text.en-US: O Lord, save me, and we will sing our psalms all the days of our life in the house of the Lord.
